phase: D/E -- routing target selection and budget curves

definitions.binary_correction: 1 if the text prediction is wrong and the fused prediction is correct, else 0. Stage 3's 'fix_logistic' target. Cannot express harm.
definitions.signed_gain: fused_correct - text_correct, in {-1, 0, +1}. The per-sample realisation of gain(m|A) = P(correct|A u {m}) - P(correct|A). Stage 3's frozen target.
definitions.class_balanced_gain: signed_gain weighted by the inverse frequency of the sample's TRUE class, normalised to mean 1. A correction on a rare class is worth more, which is what a macro average rewards and what an unweighted gain ignores.
definitions.macro_f1_marginal: macro_f1(text everywhere except this sample, fused here) minus macro_f1(text everywhere). The exact marginal contribution of acquiring on this sample to the metric the policy is graded on.
definitions.uncertainty_reduction: normalised predictive entropy of the text posterior minus that of the fused posterior. REJECTED as an HSIG target by Stage 1; carried as a control so the rejection is re-measured rather than merely cited.

target_description.why_this_matters: If most corrections fall in the largest classes, a target that counts corrections equally will send the router to samples a macro average barely rewards. The per-class breakdown above is the evidence for or against that being the Stage 3 failure mode.

correction_concentration.reading: 41% of all corrections land in 'angry' and 31% in 'happy'.

alpha_selection.criterion: out-of-fold Spearman correlation with the target, on validation
alpha_selection.why: One strength for every candidate. Tuning alpha per target would give each candidate a regularisation fitted for it, and the comparison would then be between five separately tuned models rather than between five targets.

estimator.protocol: seeded K-fold; every reported score is out of fold, so no sample contributes to the model that scores it

versus_uncertainty_only.why: Stage 3 found that a ten-feature evidence model reduced to the one-feature uncertainty model out of fold. Every richer candidate here is therefore reported as a delta against uncertainty alone, so a target that merely reproduces the gate cannot be presented as an improvement on it.

feature_set_ablation.stage3_finding: Stage 3 fitted evidence_only and evidence_plus_class alongside uncertainty_only and selected uncertainty_only: the extra nine features did not improve out-of-fold quality.
feature_set_ablation.reproduced: yes -- the richer feature sets again fail to clear uncertainty alone by 0.01 AUROC

phase_e.why_macro_f1: The pool is roughly one-third neutral. Stage 2 established that an accuracy-led reading of this corpus rewards majority-class behaviour, so accuracy is reported beside macro-F1 and never instead of it.
phase_e.reading: A policy earns its complexity only where its macro-F1 sits above the random control's 97.5th percentile at the SAME budget. Sitting inside the control interval means the same performance was available by acquiring at random, whatever the absolute numbers look like.

efficiency.reading: 'Macro-F1 retained' above 100% means the policy beat acquiring everywhere -- possible, because some acquisitions actively harm the prediction and a selective policy can decline them.

policy.measured_on: the Phase B-1 validation pass, not on the Phase D/E pool
policy.re_measurement: prohibited -- Phase E reads costs, it does not time anything
policy.audio_strong_components: frozen WAV2VEC2_BASE encoder (dominant) plus the trainable LayerWeightedProbe head
policy.why_not_the_cached_head_latency: The probe reads features the encoder already produced. At deployment the encoder runs per request, so charging only the head would understate the price of acquiring audio by roughly three orders of magnitude and would make every budget on the curve look free.
policy.compute_units: parameters x input_elements, the multiply-accumulate-order proxy used throughout this project. It is a proxy and is labelled as one.
policy.text_llm_latency: measured end-to-end wall clock from the Stage 3 pass, including queueing and cloud scheduling -- not generation time, which Stage 2 measured at roughly a fifth of it.

ablations.stage3_reference_caveat: The Stage 3 HSIG was fitted on this same 509-sample validation pool and is replayed here in sample. Its curve is optimistic by construction and is carried as a historical reference, not as a competing candidate.

rule.primary_criterion: mean validation macro-F1 over the low-budget operating region ['5%', '10%', '15%', '20%', '25%'], using out-of-fold scores
rule.admissibility_gate: the policy must exceed the matched-budget random control's 97.5th percentile macro-F1 at at least one interior budget
rule.tie_break_1: within 0.005 macro-F1, the simpler signal wins; a fitted target must clear uncertainty_only by more than that margin to be selected over it
rule.tie_break_2: higher retained fraction of the always-fusion macro-F1 gain at 10%
rule.tie_break_3: alphabetical target name, so the rule is total
rule.why_not_accuracy: Stage 2 measured that accuracy-shaped gating on this corpus buys neutral and loses macro-F1. Selecting on accuracy would reproduce that.
rule.declared: before any Phase D estimator was fitted or scored

selection.parsimony_note: uncertainty_reduction leads uncertainty_only by +0.0021 macro-F1, inside the declared 0.005 tie margin, so the simpler signal is selected. A fitted target that merely reproduces the uncertainty gate is reported as reproducing it.

operating_point.rule: smallest budget meeting every MATERIAL_ROUTING_SUCCESS condition

rule.condition_1: the selected policy's validation macro-F1 exceeds the matched-budget random control at the selected budget, above the control's 97.5th percentile
rule.condition_2: the improvement is not explained solely by majority-class corrections: summed F1 over the classes outside the two largest must also rise against text-only
rule.condition_3: the policy retains at least 50% of the always-fusion macro-F1 gain over text-only
rule.condition_4: the policy acquires audio on at most half as many samples as always-fusion
rule.not_required: beating always-fusion. Always-fusion pays for every sample; the claim under test is that most of its benefit survives paying for few.
rule.if_not_met: report ROUTING SIGNAL INSUFFICIENT and do not open the locked test split
rule.declared: before any Phase D estimator was fitted or scored

condition_2_not_only_majority_correction.why: Stage 2 showed that a gate can raise a headline metric purely by correcting neutral. Requiring the classes outside the two largest to improve is what separates routing from majority-class polish.

decision.decision: PROCEED -- freeze this policy and open the locked test split in Phase F.

rule.condition_1: the selected policy's validation macro-F1 exceeds the matched-budget random control at the selected budget, above the control's 97.5th percentile
rule.condition_2: the improvement is not explained solely by majority-class corrections: summed F1 over the classes outside the two largest must also rise against text-only
rule.condition_3: the policy retains at least 50% of the always-fusion macro-F1 gain over text-only

alignment_fingerprint.restricted_to: samples with usable Gemma evidence and cached audio features

definition.uncertainty: routing uncertainty under the frozen policy (score_entropy -> llm_normalized_score_entropy), in [0, 1]
definition.score_top2: second largest normalised self-reported class score
definition.score_entropy: Shannon entropy of the normalised score vector, in nats
definition.score_mass_top2: score_top1 + score_top2, how concentrated the answer is
definition.active_score_classes: number of classes given a non-zero score
definition.llm_confidence: the model's own self-reported confidence (NOT a posterior)
definition.llm_evidence_strength: the model's own self-reported evidence strength
definition.predicted_is_<class>: indicator that the LLM currently predicts <class>
definition.note: Every feature is computable at inference time from the LLM response alone. None is derived from a label, from the audio model, or from the fused outcome.

estimator_configuration.protocol: seeded K-fold; every reported score is out of fold, so no sample contributes to the model that scores it

policy.measured_on: the Phase B-1 validation pass, not on the Phase D/E pool
policy.re_measurement: prohibited -- Phase E reads costs, it does not time anything
policy.audio_strong_components: frozen WAV2VEC2_BASE encoder (dominant) plus the trainable LayerWeightedProbe head
policy.why_not_the_cached_head_latency: The probe reads features the encoder already produced. At deployment the encoder runs per request, so charging only the head would understate the price of acquiring audio by roughly three orders of magnitude and would make every budget on the curve look free.
policy.compute_units: parameters x input_elements, the multiply-accumulate-order proxy used throughout this project. It is a proxy and is labelled as one.
policy.text_llm_latency: measured end-to-end wall clock from the Stage 3 pass, including queueing and cloud scheduling -- not generation time, which Stage 2 measured at roughly a fifth of it.

reproducibility.replay: Every input is a stored artefact listed under 'sources'. Re-running the Phase D/E driver with the same seed reproduces every number in this record without re-scoring a model or calling the LLM.

test_lock.enforced_by: assert_validation_only() on every input path, and a driver that names no test artefact

locked_artefacts_before.note: Every locked Stage 1/2/3 and audio_strong artefact hashes identically to the recorded baseline.

locked_artefacts_after.note: Every locked Stage 1/2/3 and audio_strong artefact hashes identically to the recorded baseline.
